name: Soft Metablobby SDF
definition: A soft implicit surface consisting of n key points $p_i$ with radii $R_i$ and threshold $T$, approximating a gaussian distribution.
summary: Soft Metablobby SDF is a procedural implicit surface method using piecewise cubic polynomials to approximate Gaussian blobby fields, avoiding expensive exponentiation and providing bounded support for efficient culling.
